MACBOOK AIR · M1 · 2020

Linux for my Mac

A native Linux installation based on Fedora Asahi Remix ↗, with the KDE Plasma desktop. This project prepares installation on your Mac; it is not a new operating system built from scratch.

Opening this page does not boot Linux. Native Linux runs after installation and a restart.

1. Prepare your Mac

Official installation & device support ↗

2. Start installation from macOS

Download the launcher, then run it in Terminal using the command below. It checks for your Mac model, asks for confirmation, downloads the official installer over HTTPS, and lets you review its source before running it. Follow the official installer’s requirements for macOS version and free disk space.

bash "$HOME/Downloads/install-linux.command"

The installer changes disk partitions. Keep macOS and recovery available; do not erase the drive. Downloading this launcher alone makes no changes.

3. Boot into Linux

Complete every stage of the official installer first. After installation, shut down your Mac, then press and hold its power button until startup options appear. Select the installed Linux system and follow its boot prompts.

You can choose macOS from startup options when you need it. A browser cannot select your startup disk or restart the Mac into Linux.

Make Linux your everyday OS

Once installation is complete and your hardware works, use the distribution’s documented startup/default-boot procedure. Confirm Wi-Fi, audio, trackpad, camera, sleep and any external displays before relying on it for daily work.

Project files

The launcher and setup documentation live in projects/native-linux/. Installation happens on your Mac; the hub does not store an installed OS or claim that installation is complete.
